title: Plural of selected longer words: -oita/-öitä
focus: For these selected longer words, form the taught -oita/-öitä plural: peruna (“potato”) → perunoita.

exercises.prompt: Choose the plural partitive of peruna (“potato”).
exercises.explanation: Replace final -a with -oita: peruna → perunoita. The standard alternatives perunia and perunoja are also accepted; they replace -a with -ia and -oja respectively. This is the plural partitive of peruna (“potato”).
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Plural of selected longer words: -oita/-öitä: form or use confused
